Auth.heroSubtitle: Tell us where and when. Verified drivers send you their quotes — you compare vehicle, rating and price, then pick the one you want. Outstation trips and city rides.
Auth.verifiedDriversText: Background-checked, insured and rated by riders.
Auth.transparentPricingText: A small advance fee online; the rest is cash to the driver.
Auth.youChooseText: Compare drivers on vehicle, rating and price — no fixed menu.
Auth.footer: Verified riders · masked calls · secure payments
Auth.driverHeroSubtitle: Join YatraCab as a Captain and get booked for the routes you already run — with almost the whole fare in your pocket.
Auth.keepFullFareText: No 20–40% commission — just a small platform fee the rider pays.
Auth.steadyDemandText: Get trip alerts for your routes and vehicle — fewer empty legs.
Auth.loyaltyRewardsText: Earn points on every app-completed ride.

Home.shareSeatText: Per-seat carpooling on daily routes — pay only for your seat.
Home.referText: You refer a friend, they refer their friend — their rides earn you a % too. Lifetime, auto-credited.
Home.payOnlyYourSeat: Pay only for your seat, not the whole cab.
Home.splitFare: Split the fare — pay for one seat

Book.title: Book a ride
Book.subtitle: Tell us where and when — verified drivers send you their quotes.
Book.quoteExplainer: Drivers will quote for this trip. Your request goes to every available driver right away. You'll see each one's vehicle, seats, rating and price — pick whichever suits you.
Book.quoteExplainerLead: Drivers will quote for this trip.
Book.step1: Your trip reaches every available driver instantly.
Book.step2: They send blind quotes — no one can see anyone else's price.
Book.step3: You compare vehicle, rating and price, then accept the one you like.
Book.nothingCharged: Nothing is charged until you accept a quote.
Book.emptyText: Set your pickup and drop above to request quotes from drivers.
Book.needPickup: Pick your pickup from the list or use your location

Rewards.title: Rewards
Rewards.subtitle: Earn points, refer friends, ride for less.
Rewards.chainSubtitle: You earn on every ride they take.

Rewards.referExplainer: Refer friends. When they join you both get 50 points — then you keep earning on every ride they take, and on their friends' rides too.
Rewards.noEarningsText: Take a ride, or invite a friend — your points will show up here.
